name: EST Tools Co., Ltd
summary: EST Tools Co., Ltd. provides precision cutting and measuring tools in China and internationally. The company offers round broaches, form broaches, cold forming tools, precision measuring tools, gear cutting tools, milling tools, drilling tools, and taps. Its products are used in automobiles, wind turbines, civil aviation, construction machinery, automation and robotics, high-end equipment, rail transit, heavy truck, steel structure, and power plant equipment industries. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
